body.name: MixturePair
body.construction: Begin with the legal rough-nuisance slice \(d=1\), \(\kappa=0\), and \(\alpha+\beta<\gamma/(2\gamma+1)\): build \(\mathfrak H_n^{\mathrm{mix}}\) from a smooth squared frame on the full uniform interval, coordinated Rademacher perturbations of \(g_P\) and \(\mu_{0,P}\), and a macro contrast perturbation, and control the fixed-\(n\) Bernoulli product-mixture Hellinger distance. Only after this kill test succeeds, extend the handle to the full uniform cube by corner tapering, smooth tie-surface compensation, and the two-convex-mixture method without deleting support.
